You play as a Taichu warrior monk, fighting against other players as you all vye for the top of a special mountain, with the catch being that the game's world completely resets every 14 days.

 
Read more
articles.title: Havenhold is a neat looking East Asian mythology-inspired action sandbox game that resets its world every 14 days

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Much like many of you, I suspect, I too would love a Dishonored 3, but I'm not entirely confident it will ever happen. Arkane Austin was obviously shut down last year, and Arkane Lyon are making a Blade game, which leaves little room for a Dishonored sequel. But is there any possibility of one happening all the same? Well, still no, probably, but Arkane Studios founder and Dishonored co-creator Raphaël Colantonio did recently say that he could at the very least see himself working on a follow-up.

 
Read more
articles.title: Arkane's founder is open to the idea of making Dishonored 3, just don't place any bets on it actually happening

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Anyone up for a little shindig? NetEase clearly are, as Marvel Rivals' second season is all about the Hellfire Gala, a fun little party gone wrong hosted by Emma Frost. As you'll no doubt be aware, Emma Frost isn't in the game currently, making her the first of the new characters to join this season, which kicks off next week, April 11th. 

 
Read more
articles.title: Marvel Rivals season 2 invites you to party it up with Emma Frost, features a very Dalek-sounding Ultron

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
Alienware has revived its heaviest hitter. The Area-51 gaming laptop has officially returned and it's aiming straight for the top of the food chain. First teased back at CES 2025, the new models are available to order right now.
 Read more
articles.title: Alienware's renowned Area-51 Gaming Laptop returns with an RTX 5080 and is in stock now

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: CA/Browser Fórum odhlasovalo změnu maximální délky platnosti nově vystavovaných certifikátů. Zatímco dnes můžeme mít certifikáty uznávaných autorit v délce platnosti 398 dnů, připravuje se zkrácení na 47 dnů.
articles.title: Certifikáty pro HTTPS zkrátí postupně  do roku 2029 svou životnost na 47 dní

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Dnes si ukážeme základy práce s instrukcemi AVX v assembleru, konkrétně v Netwide Assembleru běžícího v Linuxu. Samotné AVX (Advanced Vector Extensions) rozšiřuje možnosti vektorových instrukcí na x86 i x86–64.
articles.title: Rozšíření instrukční sady AVX a programy v assembleru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: ČD - Telematika)
articles.description: V dnešním díle se podíváme na novou slabinu v desktopové aplikaci WhatsApp, na nový nástroj spammerů AkiraBot, závažnou zranitelnost v pluginu OttoKit a kritickou zranitelnost v zařízeních FortiSwitch.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: WhatsApp spustí malware maskovaný jako obrázek

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Komunita ArcoLinux oznámila, že ukončí vývoj své distribuce a souvisejících projektů. Tým UBports implementoval VoLTE do svého operačního systému. Instalační program openSUSE s názvem Agama představil různá vylepšení.
articles.title: Distribuce ArcoLinux končí, UBports testuje ve svém systému VoLTE

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Vylepšení dokumentace oprav na Spectre RSB v jádru Linux 6.15, podpora Intel Xe3 v Panther Lake pro Linux 6.16, týden v GNOME #195 nejen o portování Počasí na TypeScript, AMD ROCm 6.4 bez oficiální podpory RDNA4 Radeonů.
articles.title: KDE začíná s obnovou sezení na Waylandu, Intel přepracuje VRR pro svoje GPU

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Dvaačtyřicáté vydání Fedory se blíží, máme tu beta verzi a jak všichni dobře víme, 42 je odpovědí na základní otázku všeho. Rozhodl jsem se tuto výzvu vyslyšet a opět po několik vydáních zkusit tuto oblíbenou distribuci.
articles.title: Fedora 42 pohledem cizince v cizí zemi

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Martin Beran)
articles.description: Co se děje v procesoru, když vykonává strojový kód? Jak se načítají, dekódují a provádějí jednotlivé instrukce? Jak procesor přistupuje k paměti? Co se stane, když přijde přerušení?
articles.title: Navrhujeme a vyrábíme vlastní CPU: mikroarchitektura procesoru

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Ukázali jsme si tvorbu MCP klientů i serverů v Pythonu s využitím oficiální MCP knihovny, zatímco dnes se zaměříme na jazyk Go, pro který oficiální knihovna prozatím není k dispozici.
articles.title: Realizace MCP klientů i serverů v jazyku Go

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Na konferenci Peering Days, která se konala 25. a 27. března v chorvatském Splitu, se odborníci z oblasti počítačových sítí sešli, aby hovořili o síle open-source síťování, škálování FIB a doporučených postupech v peeringu.
articles.title: Open-source síťování, škálování FIB, trendy v peeringu, Peering Days 2025

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes si uspořádáme knihovnu médií, vyzkoušíme expandér textu, podíváme se na terminál používající webové technologie a pustíme si internetové rádio.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (9. 4. 2025): spravujte svou rozsáhlou knihovnu médií

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Hra Metro 2033 Redux slaví 15. narozeniny a při této příležitosti je zdarma na Steamu a GOG.com. Jde o postapokalyptickou střílečku.
articles.title: Hra Metro 2033 Redux zdarma na Steamu a GOG.com

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vilém Sládek)
articles.description: Do tohoto pátku je otevřena výzva pro přihlašování přednášek na konferenci Den IPv6. Přihlašovat je možné příspěvky o délce 20 nebo 40 minut či 10minutové lighting talky. Vítány jsou návrhy přednášek z akademického i komerčního sektoru – technického i netechnického zaměření.
articles.title: Konference Den IPv6: blíží se uzávěrka přihlašování přednášek

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Platnost certifikátů HTTPS a DCV (Domain Control Validation) je v současnosti 398 dní. Letos Apple navrhl ve fóru CA/Browse postupné zkrácení jejich platnosti. Návrh podpořily také Sectigo, tým Google Chrome a Mozilla.
articles.title: Platnost TLS certifikátů bude v roce 2029 omezena na 47 dní

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Minulý týden bylo oznámeno, že Linux Mint Debian Edition 7 (LMDE) dostane podporu pro OEM instalace. To tradiční Linux Mint založený na Ubuntu má již nějakou dobu. Hned se vyrojily spekulace, jestli Linux Mint nepřechází z Ubuntu na Debian.
articles.title: Linux Mint Debian Edition 7 má podporu pro OEM instalace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Společnost SpaceX oznámila, že kompaktní Starlink Mini je nyní dostupný pro objednání a brzké odeslání zákazníkům v České republice. Jde o kompaktní a lehkou verzi družicové internetové služby Starlink pro situace, kdy není k dispozici běžné místní internetové pokrytí.
articles.title: Starlink Mini je dostupný v Česku, kompaktní verze je velká jako notebook

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Webové prohlížeče běžně zobrazují navštívené odkazy (:visited) jinou barvou (fialová) než nenavštívené (modrá). Toto mohou zneužít některé webové stránky a zjistit tak, které odkazy uživatel již navštívil. Psali jsme o tom v roce 2008 v článku CSS exploit a neexistující soukromí na webu.
articles.title: Chrome 136 po 20 letech napraví problém se soukromím navštívených odkazů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: AmigaOS je proprietární grafický OS pro legendární počítače Amiga a AmigaOne. Před dvěma týdny vyšla verze 3.2.3, která opravuje přes 50 chyb. Operační systém AmigaOS 3.0 vyšel v roce 1992, což je již 33 let.
articles.title: AmigaOS 3.2.3 pro Motorola 68K

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Docker je dnes technologie, která proces vývoje, testování a provozování softwaru velmi zjednodušuje. Provozujte cokoliv a kdekoliv. Už nečekejte na nastavení svého serveru nebo na aktualizaci nějaké knihovny. Mějte prostředí jako součást vaší aplikace.
articles.title: Naučte se pracovat s Dockerem a kontejnery (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vyšklebená tlama)
articles.description: Společnost Broadcom uvolnila aktuální verzi ESXi 8.0u3e ke stažení bezplatně pro stávající registrované uživatele. Klíčové je, že pro již dříve registrované, tzn. bezplatná je v podstatě jen pro uživatele, kteří si účet zaregistrovali ještě před akvizicí Broadcomem. Po ní již totiž nebylo možné bezplatné účty registrovat a podmínkou jejich získání je placení předplatného.
articles.title: Broadcom uvolnil bezplatnou verzi ESXi 8.0u3e, ale jen pro stávající uživatele

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Čínský výrobce Radxa uvedl duální 2.5G HAT s M.2 pro Raspberry Pi a Radxa Rock 2F, Rock 2A, Rock 5C a Rock 4D. Připojuje se plochým kabelem do PCIe a také umožňuje připojit i další zařízení plochým kabelem.
articles.title: Radxa duální 2.5G HAT s M.2 pro Raspberry Pi i jiné SBC Radxa

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Malé a levné desky ESP32-C3 SuperMini s USB-C jsou oblíbené, ale kvůli velikostnímu omezení mívají slabý dosah WiFi. Peter Neufeld přidal ke keramické anténě 31 mm postříbřený drát o průměru 1 mm a vytvořil tak λ/4 anténu.
articles.title: Vylepšená WiFi anténa pro ESP32-C3 SuperMini má až třikrát lepší dosah

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Nginx je dnes přibližně na třetině web serverů na internetu a toto číslo stále roste. Je výkonný, spolehlivý, má spoustu funkcí a dobře se spravuje. Pokud potřebujete dobrý web server pro svůj projekt, bude Nginx správnou volbou.
articles.title: Nasaďte moderní web server s Nginx (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera vyšel standardní kompresní nástroj Gzip ve verzi 1.14. Na x86 s podporou PCMUL je při rozbalování rychlejší asi o 40 %. Zhruba polovinu času při rozbalování zabíral výpočet CRC32 a ten je nyní rychlejší.
articles.title: Gzip 1.14 s rychlejším rozbalováním

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Framework Computer slíbila, že od 9. dubna bude možné předobjednávat nové notebooky Framework Laptop 12. Ty byly představeny v únoru a budou dodávány v pěti barevných variantách: černá, šedá, levandulová, žvýkačková a šalvějová.
articles.title: Framework Laptop 12 už je možné objednat, cena začíná na 14 tisících korunách

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Na blogu bezpečnostního týmu projektu Firefox vyšel článek, za kterým stojí Tom Schuster, Frederik Braun a Christoph Kerschbaumer. Popisují v něm nedávné změny, které proběhly v uživatelském prostředí prohlížeče Firefox. Jejich cílem bylo zvýšit odolnost proti útokům na rozhraní z webových stránek.
articles.title: Zabezpečení uživatelského rozhraní Firefoxu pomocí CSP

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Nástroj rsync slouží v unixových operačních systémech pro přenos a synchronizaci souborů mezi různými počítači. Je už také dlouho součástí operačního systému macOS, ale Apple v něm stále udržuje prastarou verzi 2.6.9 vydanou v listopadu 2006. Už v březnu 2008 přitom vyšel rsync 3.0, ale Apple tuto novou řadu ignoruje.
articles.title: Apple v macOS Sequoia nasadil openrsync místo klasického rsync

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)

Zatímco Oracle tvrdí, že se jedná o historická data z osm let starého serveru, jiný zákazník uvedl, že mezi kompromitovanými údaji jsou i přihlašovací data z roku 2024.

The release date for EA Sports FC 26, or EA FC 26 in short, is doing the rounds on social media.


While EA Sports has revealed nothing official yet, a new leak has emerged on X from AhcanFUT, who's a reliable name in the community. According to them, EA Sports is potentially looking at an earlier release window compared to the usual pattern. The leak also includes some interesting information relating to crossplay.


EA Sports FC 26 release date (leaked)


If the rumors are to be believed, EA FC 26 will be released on August 23 for Ultimate Edition users. If EA Sports follows the same pattern that they did for FC 25, the full launch will take place on August 30. The Ultimate Edition, as usual, is expected to have several benefits, including early access.


The leak also suggests that there will be a gameplay trailer between May 20 and May 27. The exact nature of what will be revealed to us is unknown at this point. EA Sports could end up giving us the first trailer for the upcoming game, but it's better to wait for official information before reaching a conclusion.


EA Sports FC 26 crossplay changes


EA FC 26 is expected to be released on both generations of consoles, along with PC. EA Sports will likely offer special editions for the Nintendo Switch and the Nintendo Switch 2. While crossplay between the same generational devices will be there, console and PC users will no longer be able to play together.


This will be a major change from how crossplay works in EA FC 25. In the current game, those on the current generation consoles of Xbox and PlayStation can match with and against PC users. EA Sports is finally set to make the much requested change after all.


It's worth noting that all the information presented in the article are in the form of leaks. Readers are advised to take the news with a grain of salt, and some of the actual meaning of the original tweet could have been lost in translation.

The Swim Trunks is one of the many items you can come across in Blue Prince, but the game doesn't tell you anything about what to do with them.


The chance of this item spawning is based on luck, so if you have found it, consider yourself lucky. They are used later in a spoiler tied with the Pool room. This guide will provide you with all the important info regarding the trunks if you manage to find them on your save.


What do the Swim Trunks in Blue Prince?


The Swim Trunks on their own don't have any use. You can neither use them nor combine them to produce something else. That doesn't automatically mean that they're completely useless. In fact, finding these trunks will automatically spawn something in the Pool room.


The Pool usually has coins available at the bottom. They will be replaced by a couple of floating Trunks (the container, not the Swim Trunks). You can open these trunks through a couple of different methods.


How to open Locked Trunks in Blue Prince?


The first way is to use keys to open them. Ordinary keys will work just fine, but it's better to save them to open doors. Opening doors in Blue Prince is far more important, as it will get you closer to your final goal.


Image via Dogubomb


A better method is to use the sledgehammers. You can find this item in certain rooms, but it ultimately depends on luck. In case you can't find one in your room, you can just buy them from the Commissary. While this method requires Gold Coins, it's far more effective. Moreover, once you buy the Sledgehammer, you can use it as many times as you like.


Trunks can include valuable items in them, including Gold Coins and Dice. It's all down to luck on what you might get. If you'd like to see more, here are all the items and their locations in Blue Prince.

Separately, a brief from law professors argues that Meta's unauthorized copying to train Llama is an "undeniably commercial" use that provides no new transformative meaning and shouldn't qualify as fair use.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta AI ‘Piracy’ Lawsuit: Publishers and Professors Challenge Fair Use Defense

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Site blocking and similar censorship measures are vulnerable to circumvention, helping to popularize VPNs and other encrypted solutions all over the world. That includes Spain, where LaLiga is ramping up its pirate site blocking efforts and at the same time (and with the court's blessing) rendering thousands of innocent sites inaccessible due to overblocking. People are now fighting back against dystopia, transforming conventional site blocking workarounds into tools that reinstate freedom of expression.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Block Mirror: Dystopian Site-Blocking Triggers Circumvention Innovation

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Under a court order obtained by LaLiga and Telefonica, Spanish ISPs now conduct broad blocking of live pirated sports streams. These measures target shared Cloudflare infrastructure and have many third-party intermediaries concerned due to widespread overblocking. The Catalan (.cat) domain registry is actively monitoring domains for fallout and says it reserves the right to take legal action.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Domain Registry Investigates Spain’s Piracy Overblocking Damage

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Adult entertainment company Flava Works is demanding millions in damages in a new lawsuit targeting members of a private gay torrent site. The complaint names the alleged Canadian leaker, who is accused of distributing content downloaded from Flava's paid sites, and 47 'John Doe' defendants who are identified only by their GayTorrent.Ru usernames.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Porn Producer Targets Members of Gay Torrent Site in Court

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
LaLiga's court-ordered authority to block Cloudflare IP addresses to disrupt pirate IPTV services continues to black out large numbers of entirely legal sites. Interestingly, LaLiga's opinion differs quite drastically; maybe just a handful have been affected, but certainly not lots. A report that a UK-based CDN isolates pirates means LaLiga doesn't have to block it. A network specialist claims that LaLiga went ahead and blocked it anyway.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: CDN77 Isolates LaLiga IPTV Pirates in 15 mins. Allegedly Gets Blocked Anyway

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Internet Archive's 'Great 78 Project' digitizes historical recordings to preserve musical heritage, but in 2023 the initiative led to major record labels filing a copyright lawsuit. The financial stakes soared last month when the labels proposed to update their claim to $693 million in statutory damages. A recent filing suggests that due to significant progress in settlement discussions, it may not come to that.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Internet Archive vs. Music Labels: $600m+ Copyright Rift Edges Toward Settlement

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Tech and communications group CCIA has listed dozens of recommendations in its response to a public consultation on regulatory amendments concerning the Piracy Shield IPTV blocking system.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Tech Giants Propose “Critical” Piracy Shield Regulation Amendments

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Pay TV provider DISH Network has filed a complaint against the yet unidentified operators of the popular 'pirate' streaming services Lemo TV and Kemo IPTV. The lawsuit, filed in a Texas federal court, is coordinated by the International Broadcaster Coalition Against Piracy (IBCAP). It accuses the IPTV operators of widespread copyright infringement and seeks more than $25 million in potential damages. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DISH Sues ‘Pirate’ IPTV Services Lemo and Kemo in U.S. Court

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A report in Belgian media on Saturday evening claimed that in conjunction with local ISPs, broadcasters DAZN and 12th Player had just launched a major campaign against more than 100 illegal streaming services and IPTV providers. Documents seen by TorrentFreak show that a court order required public DNS resolver operators Cloudflare, Google, and Cisco, to render over 130 domains inaccessible or face fines of €100,000 per day for non-compliance.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DAZN Pirate IPTV Action Coincided With Massive Public DNS Blockade

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A Premier League DMCA subpoena requires Cloudflare to hand over the details of individuals behind 38 pirate streaming sites. Before that process could even begin, the Premier League needed to obtain certain information about the pirate sites to support its claims. Today we'll attempt to recreate the toolkit used to gather that information and, if all goes to plan, it won't cost a single penny,
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloning Premier League’s Pirate Site DMCA Subpoena Toolkit

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In the seemingly endless game of online piracy whack-a-mole, a French court has ordered Cloudflare to block several sites illegally streaming MotoGP. The ruling is an escalation of French blocking measures that began increasing their scope beyond traditional ISPs in the last few months of 2024. Obtained by MotoGP rightsholder Canal+, the order applies to all Cloudflare services, including DNS, and can be updated with 'future' domains. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: French Court Orders Cloudflare to ‘Dynamically’ Block MotoGP Streaming Piracy

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
With assistance from Spain's leading ISPs, LaLiga continues to block pirate sites, Cloudflare, and thousands of innocents caught in the crossfire. Legal action by Cloudflare and hacking collective RootedCON tried to bring the chaos to an end but their requests were dismissed last month. Meanwhile, a non-profit group is demanding that all ISPs participate in nationwide blocking.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: LaLiga/Cloudflare Crisis: ISPs Urged to Action Amid Mass Overblocking

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Ahead of its long-delayed American premiere, an unfinished 'workprint' copy of "A Minecraft Movie" is circulating on pirate sites. Warner Bros. is trying to contain this and other leaks, but that may prove difficult.  The incident mirrors the infamous 2009 X-Men Origins: Wolverine workprint leak and the involvement of the FBI, which led to the arrest and conviction of an uploader. The source of that leak was never publicly disclosed. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Unfinished Copy of ‘A Minecraft Movie’ Leaks on Pirate Sites

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After a long hiatus, site blocking proposals have resurfaced in the U.S. Congress. The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) strongly opposes these plans, condemning site blocking as ineffective against piracy but still a
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: EFF Vows to Fight Back Against U.S. Site Blocking Bills

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A group of prominent intellectual property law professors has weighed in on the high-stakes AI copyright battle between several authors and Meta. In an amicus brief, the scholars argue that using copyrighted content as training data can be considered fair use under U.S. copyright law, if the goal is to create a new and 'transformative' tool. This suggests that fair use could potentially apply to Meta's training process, even if the underlying data was obtained without permission.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Training AI Using ‘Pirated’ Content Can Be Fair Use, Law Professors Argue

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A bill that aims to further undermine operators of restricted platforms including Meta, Instagram, and X will have a much wider effect when it's expected to come into force in September. The amendments ban the placement of advertising on any blocked site in Russia, regardless of reason. Submitted in 2024, the bill will affect thousands of pirate sites and Russia's rapidly growing influencer market.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Advertising Banned on All Sites Blocked in Russia Starting September

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Piracy poses a major threat to the Premier League's broadcast rights, prompting it to take continued action against rogue streaming sites. Hoping to unmask the anonymous operators behind dozens of pirate sites, the league has obtained a DMCA subpoena against Cloudflare in the United States. While Cloudflare is expected to comply, the usability of the information it holds remains uncertain.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Premier League Subpoena Requires Cloudflare to Unmask Streaming Pirates

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (mduggan)
articles.description:
We are excited to announce the classic Dynamix adventure games The Adventures of Willy Beamish and Heart of China are now ready for testing in ScummVM!
As the titular Willy Beamish, you play a 9-year-old troublemaker from Frumpton, USA. All you want to do is play Nintari and hang out with your friends, but your parents keep giving you so many chores... and even when you get them done, larger and more sinister forces are at work in your small town. A kid can't get a break!
In Heart of China, you start as retired WWI pilot Jake "Lucky" Masters. After a run-in with Hong Kong businessman E.A. Lomax, you feel driven by a strong sense of duty (and your massive debts!) to help him track down his kidnapped daughter. Work your way through a branching plot and the opportunity to play as three different characters to solve the puzzles and get Kate home.
Along with the previously announced Rise of the Dragon, these games complete Dynamix's short series of adventure games using the DGDS engine.
To test these games, you’ll need a DOS version of the game (both are available from GOG) and a daily development build. Be sure to check the notes on the wiki for each game, and please report any bugs on our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: The Dynamix duo of Willy Beamish and Heart of China are ready for testing

articles.description: April 1st has come and gone, but have no fear, for beta2 is here. We’ve fixed a bunch more since beta1, and need more testing. Also, we added some new features! Highlights include: Snow-covered rocks are now visible Steep hills from map generation or heightmap import now get extra rocks Houses can be individually placed by players in the scenario editor and (if enabled) in-game, and can be protected from replacement during town growth Touchpad two-finger map scrolling for Windows NewGRF Badges A variety of bugfixes (As always, see the changelog for further details). What are badges, you ask? Badges are something add-on (NewGRF) authors can put on their content to help you find e.g. the vehicle or station you want to use. For example, various vehicle add-ons use a mix of different icons, overlay images or texts to indicate the power source or the suggested usage of a vehicle. With badges, this information can be represented in a clear way including built-in filtering, that is cohesive between different add-ons. As this beta is the first release featuring badge support, there aren’t many updated add-ons yet, but we’re excited to see what authors do with the new feature. Finally, the usual titlegame competition has been announced on the forums. Download Changelog Bug tracker

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description:
Ať si o jeho skladatelských kvalitách myslíte cokoliv, Hans Zimmer je dnes pravděpodobně nejslavnějším a nejlépe placeným skladatelem filmové hudby. A je jedním z hybatelů změny filmové hudby jako takové, od symfonických kompozic minulých desetiletí k elektronické / rockové jednoduchosti současnosti. Více jsem o této změně vyplodil zde a jsem na to pyšný.
Ale zpět k Zimmerovi.
Tento film (který bude uveden 19.3. v našich kinech, ale ne v mnoha) je záznamem jeho nedávného koncertu v Dubaji, ale jde o mnohem víc, než jen o záznam koncertu.
Především, Zimmerovy koncerty vždycky byly velká podívaná a ani v tomto případě tomu není jinak.

Znamená to mimo jiné, že všichni hudebníci mají pečlivě sladěné oblečení a líčení, v sále je spousta reflektorů, laserů, video mappingu a všeho možného. Navíc…
articles.title: Recenze: Hans Zimmer & Friends: Diamond in the Desert - 80 %

It was discovered that the CImg library did not properly check the size
of images before loading them. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.
(CVE-2022-1325)

It was discovered that the CImg library did not correctly handle certain
memory operations, which could lead to a buffer overflow. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial
of service. (CVE-2024-26540)
articles.title: USN-7437-1: CImg library vulnerabilities

articles.description:
Several security issues were discovered in the WebKitGTK Web and JavaScript
engines. If a user were tricked into viewing a malicious website, a remote
attacker could exploit a variety of issues related to web browser security,
including cross-site scripting attacks, denial of service attacks, and
arbitrary code execution.
articles.title: USN-7436-1: WebKitGTK vulnerabilities

articles.description:
It was discovered that Protocol Buffers incorrectly handled memory when
receiving malicious input using the Java bindings. An attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
articles.title: USN-7435-1: Protocol Buffers vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that Perl incorrectly handled transliterating non-ASCII
bytes. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause Perl to crash,
resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.
articles.title: USN-7434-1: Perl vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that GraphicsMagick did not properly limit image
dimensions, which could lead to excessive memory consumption. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
(CVE-2025-27795)

It was discovered that GraphicsMagick did not properly handle certain
memory operations, which could lead to a out-of-bounds memory access. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to leak sensitive information.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.10. (CVE-2025-27796)
articles.title: USN-7433-1: GraphicsMagick vulnerabilities

articles.description:
It was discovered that libsoup could be made to read out of bounds. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using
libsoup to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-2784,
CVE-2025-32050, CVE-2025-32052, CVE-2025-32053)

It was discovered that libsoup could be made to dereference invalid
memory. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications
using libsoup to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
(CVE-2025-32051)
articles.title: USN-7432-1: libsoup vulnerabilities

articles.description:

arbitrary code.
articles.title: USN-7431-1: HAProxy vulnerability
